more.good_when: A maintainer who writes a case where claude is run more than once, such as a second try while the limit holds, gets from called() every call, as the module's opening ("it adds to the file that CALLS names in its environment a line") and called()'s docstring ("Each call of the double kept in the file") say; in the trial, two runs of the double gave called() only the second call.

A maintainer who writes a new case and leaves CLAUDE_DOUBLE_CALLS out of the environment that resume runs in learns at once that the double was run without that variable, and so knows to add it; in the trial, the case waited 30 seconds and then said "claude wasn't called within 30.0 seconds", though the waiter had run the double.
